run_hydra_app: run the Hydra app my_app that prints db driver and timeout from config
run_hydra_sweep: run a Hydra multi-run sweep over db options and timeout values using my_app
run_hydra_app_with_db: run the Hydra app my_app with a specific db config like mysql or postgresql
review_hydra_main_decorator: review the hydra.main decorator usage with version_base, config_path, and config_name
review_dictconfig_usage: review how my_app accesses nested config values like cfg.db.driver and cfg.db.timeout
